description:
Kim Min-jae refuses to date but is thirsty for sex.   
It's called "Eumpa Eumpa”, which saves a sex partner from his friend. As soon as the app is introduced, access immediately (^^) but from the first meeting, the boss doesn't come out...  
With the emergency light turned on for the safety of sex life, he's connected to Han Junhee, who's been filled with his perfect ideal type...!

**Original Manhwa:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4895000017), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055646), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/umpaumpa), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/EUMPAEUNPA), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=220850), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9478265)

***Note:**  
Only Ridibooks has the Volumes (eBook) while other platforms have the single chapters. As of Nov 3rd 2022, the eBook along with other platforms were removed. Ridibooks has now added a scroll version, the series is now revised as a scroll webtoon than a page format. The single chapters before also had a page format.*
